company_summary: Adept is an enterprise AI company that enhances productivity by automating manual and repetitive workflows across various tools used by teams. Their core product utilizes agentic AI, integrating multimodal models and custom software to translate user intents into actions across websites and applications. Recently, the company has been focused on building a future where AI helps every employee focus on meaningful work, but no specific news or funding stage is mentioned. With 35,212 followers on LinkedIn, Adept's team size is not explicitly stated, but the company appears to be a growing enterprise with a significant online presence.
